info.name: Courtee API
info.description: Start the seeded backend with COURTEE_ANALYZER=fake. Run every folder in order. Each run creates new message IDs and checks changes against existing data.

exec: pm.test("Sara can choose her two dossiers", () => { pm.expect(m.candidates).to.deep.eql(["D-2041","D-2077"]); });

pm.test("Saved messages belong to this dossier", () => { pm.expect(data.messages.map(m=>m.id).sort((a,b)=>a-b)).to.deep.eql(baseline.ids.concat([Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_A")),Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_G")),Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_H")),Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_K")),Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_L")),Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_PHONE")),Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_REFERENCES"))]).sort((a,b)=>a-b)); });

pm.test("Newest messages first", () => { for(let i=1;i<data.messages.length;i++){const a=data.messages[i-1],b=data.messages[i];pm.expect(a.date>b.date || (a.date===b.date && a.id>b.id)).to.eql(true);} });

pm.test("Automatic actions recorded in history", () => { pm.expect(data.history.length).to.eql(baseline.history+2);for(const c of ["ATTACHMENT","DOCUMENT"]){pm.expect(data.history.find(h=>h.message_id===Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_"+c))).applied_by).to.eql("auto");}pm.expect(data.document_requests.length).to.eql(baseline.documents+1); });

pm.test("Replay preserves applied proposal and analysis", () => { pm.expect(data.duplicate).to.eql(true);pm.expect(data.message.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_AGREEMENT")));pm.expect(data.message.analysis).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("agreement_analysis")));pm.expect(data.message.proposals.find(p=>p.id===Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("approve_id"))).status).to.eql("applied"); });

pm.test("Rejection leaves dossier and history unchanged", () => { pm.expect(data.dossier.status).to.eql(baseline.status);pm.expect(data.history.length).to.eql(baseline.history);pm.expect(data.messages.find(m=>m.id===Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("id_REJECT"))).proposals[0].status).to.eql("rejected"); });
